item.title: Capture: AQ create answer (#531)
item.body:
Closes #531
Refs #81, #224
Claim: mac/m2-lead

**Problem.** LOT-055 could not call an AQ creation a success: no answer of `addAlerte.php` was captured.

**Capture.** `T50`: 200 `text/plain;charset=UTF-8`, body `1`, no cookie. `T51`: `getAlertesByTopic.php` then lists it. One public write, approved by the operator (write log on #531). A refusal is not captured.

**Kit.** Position-based checks for AQ pages (`verify_aq_own`, `tests/test_aq_own.py`).

**Tests.** Kit tests, `check --corpus`, `swift test`, pre-commit green. Independent check passed.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
<!-- coderabbit-ai-generated:v1 -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Documentation**
  * Updated the protocol reference with a verified alert-creation response: HTTP 200 with a plain-text body of `1`.
  * Added an example showing the created alert in the topic’s alert list, including its submitted pseudonym and post reference.
  * Clarified that refusal behavior has not been verified and that response bodies other than `1` remain unclassified.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

review_comments.body:
** Trivial** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Make the create-body check cover every field, as the docstring states.** The docstring says the verifier checks "every field". The code checks eight named fields only. Two gaps follow: - `dict(parse_qsl(...))` keeps the last value of a duplicated key. A body such as `nom=&nom=Alert+title` passes. - A field outside the eight, for example a new field with a real value, is never inspected. `alerte_qualitay_id` is also not checked. This verifier is the redactor-independent gate. A value that the redactor misses must not pass here. The check also runs for every AQ-host meta that has a `request_body`. A different AQ write endpoint would fail with "topic_id not an alias". Restrict the check to `addAlerte.php` when more AQ writes are captured.
Proposed fix

```diff - f = dict(urllib.parse.parse_qsl(body, keep_blank_values=True)) + pairs = urllib.parse.parse_qsl(body, keep_blank_values=True) + f = dict(pairs) + if len(f) != len(pairs): + bad("duplicate field in the request body") + known = {"alerte_qualitay_id", "nom", "topic_id", "topic_titre", "pseudo", "post_id", "post_url", + "commentaire"} + if set(f) - known: + bad("unknown field in the request body") + if f.get("alerte_qualitay_id") != "-1": + bad("alerte_qualitay_id unexpected") ```
Committable suggestion

> **IMPORTANT** > Review the replacement and indentation, then test before committing. ```suggestion pairs = urllib.parse.parse_qsl(body, keep_blank_values=True) f = dict(pairs) if len(f) != len(pairs): bad("duplicate field in the request body") known = {"alerte_qualitay_id", "nom", "topic_id", "topic_titre", "pseudo", "post_id", "post_url", "commentaire"} if set(f) - known: bad("unknown field in the request body") if f.get("alerte_qualitay_id") != "-1": bad("alerte_qualitay_id unexpected") if not _V_AQ_FAKE_TOPIC.fullmatch(f.get("topic_id", "")): bad("topic_id not an alias") if not _V_AQ_FAKE_MESSAGE.fullmatch(f.get("post_id", "")): bad("post_id not an alias") if f.get("topic_titre") != OWN_SUBJECT: bad("topic_titre not an alias") if f.get("nom") != OWN_ALERT_TITLE: bad("nom (alert title) not a placeholder") if not FAKE_NAME_RE.fullmatch(f.get("pseudo", "")): bad("pseudo not an alias") if not re.fullmatch(r"post de user\d+", f.get("commentaire", "")): bad("commentaire not an alias") if not re.fullmatch(r"https://forum\.hardware\.fr/hfr/%s/%s/%s-sujet_99\d{5}_\d+\.htm#t991\d{7}" % (OWN_CATEGORY, OWN_SUBCATEGORY, OWN_SLUG), f.get("post_url", "")): bad("post_url (category, slug, topic or message id) not an alias") ```
